definition: 支付方式分析以 payments 表为主，按 method 字段分组统计。

metrics.name: 各支付方式占比
metrics.sql_template: SELECT method, COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER() FROM payments GROUP BY method

metrics.name: 各支付方式金额
metrics.sql_template: SELECT method, SUM(paid_amount) FROM payments GROUP BY method

metrics.name: 优惠券使用率
metrics.sql_template: COUNT(CASE WHEN method = 'coupon' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) FROM payments
